indication_area: Hematology (reversal of factor Xa inhibitor anticoagulation in life-threatening bleeding)
geography: United States (Portola's 'Andexxa' row; European sales are printed separately as 'Ondexxya')
moa: Recombinant modified factor Xa decoy that binds factor Xa inhibitors

approval_evidence.quote: We received approval for Andexxa and Bevyxxa in May 2018 and June 2017, respectively.

launch_evidence.quote: To date, our source of product revenue has been from the U.S. sales of Andexxa and Bevyxxa, which we began shipping to customers in May 2018 and January 2018, respectively.

series_end_reason: Alexion acquired Portola on 2 July 2020; Portola's last periodic report is the 10-Q for the quarter ended 31 March 2020 (0001628280-20-007433). The continuation (Alexion's U.S. row 2020Q3-2021Q1, AstraZeneca's US column 2021Q4-2024Q4) is staged as the joined series astrazeneca_andexxa (staging_joined).
notes: Portola U.S. Andexxa net product revenue, USD (printed in thousands).
search_log: Listed Portola Pharmaceuticals (CIK 1269021, 608 filings), Alexion Pharmaceuticals (CIK 899866) and AstraZeneca (CIK 901832) filings via data.sec.gov submissions; located documents with EDGAR full-text search for 'Andexxa' (Portola 2018-2020, Alexion 2020-2021, AstraZeneca 2020-2026).

Scope is U.S.: Portola prints no worldwide Andexxa line. Its 'Andexxa' row is U.S. sales (10-Q Q2 2018: 'our product revenue consists of the U.S. sales of Andexxa'), and from Q3 2019 European sales appear on a separate 'Ondexxya' row (2,775 thousand in Q3 2019); adding the two would be a sum of regions, so the U.S. row is the series.

Portola's Q4 releases print only total 'Product revenue, net' (Andexxa plus Bevyxxa) in tables; 2018Q4 is the release headline figure ($14.0 million; FY 2018 10-K row 23,995 less the Q3 2018 10-Q nine-month row 9,960 = 14,035 thousand) and 2019Q4 the preliminary release's U.S. figure (approximately $24 million; 10-K FY 2019 row 104,529 less nine months 80,326 = 24,203 thousand).
